name: Fűzvölgy (Hungary)
description: A vertical blue banner with a white cross, charged at the crossing with the municipal arms of Fűzvölgy: a quartered red and blue shield with a crown, a cross, a fleur-de-lis and a tree.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.
